enriched.summary: A aula aborda gramática com foco no uso do Past Simple e Past Continuous, além de vocabulário útil para situações cotidianas, como chamadas telefônicas e interações de negócios. Também inclui prática com frases e histórias curtas para consolidar os conceitos.
mainTopics: Vocabulário relacionado a chamadas telefônicas e negócios

vocabulary.definition: To end a phone call by disconnecting the line.
examples: The customer hung up while the agent was looking for their account details.

vocabulary.definition: To direct your eyes towards something.
examples: She looked at the painting for hours.

vocabulary.definition: To search for something or someone.
examples: The agent was looking for their account details.

vocabulary.definition: To make someone believe something that is not true.
examples: He deceived everyone with his lies.

vocabulary.definition: To be confined in a prison.
examples: He has been in jail for three years.

vocabulary.definition: A regular pattern of sounds or movements.
examples: The song has a catchy rhythm.

vocabulary.definition: Used to indicate that something is not true in all cases.
examples: He’s not always late, but it happens often.
He is known for his generosity.

vocabulary.definition: To fall or let something fall.
Someone who serves or assists others.
examples: The flight attendant offered drinks to passengers.

grammar.explanation: The Past Simple is used for completed actions in the past, while the Past Continuous is used for actions that were ongoing at a specific time in the past.
rules: Use Past Simple for actions that are completed: 'He turned 10 last week.'
Use Past Continuous for actions in progress: 'While we were singing, some balloons burst.'
examples: The customer hung up while the agent was looking for their account details.
The sales team was celebrating their success when the manager announced more work.
While the analysts were studying the market trends, the stock price dropped suddenly.
commonMistakes: Using Past Continuous for completed actions: 'He was turned 10 last week.' (Incorrect)
Confusing Past Simple with Past Continuous: 'While the analysts studied the market trends, the stock price dropped suddenly.' (Incorrect tense)

expressions.usage: Used when ending a phone call.
examples: The customer hung up while the agent was looking for their account details.
The agent was looking for their account details.

practiceQuestions.question: Complete: The customer ___ while the agent ___ for their account details.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The Past Simple ('hung up') shows the completed action, and the Past Continuous ('was looking') shows the ongoing action interrupted.

practiceQuestions.question: Translate: Minha mãe foi criada por seus primos.
practiceQuestions.answer: My mother was brought up by her cousins.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The phrase uses 'brought up', which means 'criada' in this context.

culturalNotes: In English-speaking cultures, celebrations like birthdays often include singing 'Happy Birthday' and decorating spaces with balloons.
studyTips: Practice contrasting Past Simple and Past Continuous by creating your own short stories.
Use songs to learn vocabulary related to 'lyrics' and 'rhythm'.
originalExamples: The customer hung up while the agent was looking for their account details. (O cliente desligou enquanto o atendente estava procurando os detalhes da conta.)
The sales team was celebrating their success when the manager announced more work. (A equipe de vendas estava celebrando seu sucesso quando o gerente anunciou mais trabalho.)
While the analysts were studying the market trends, the stock price dropped suddenly. (Enquanto os analistas estudavam as tendências do mercado, o preço das ações caiu repentinamente.)
My mother was brought up by her cousins. (Minha mãe foi criada por seus primos.)

In this photo, we were celebrating Raoul's birthday at his school. He turned 10 last week. (Nesta foto, estávamos celebrando o aniversário de Raoul na escola dele. Ele completou 10 anos na semana passada.)
